dogecoin.text:
The SEC's willingness to review Dogecoin and XRP ETF applications marks a shift in its stance on altcoin ETFs.

Source: CryptoSlate https://t.co/XGdJIXt1AJ

The SEC has delayed decisions on XRP, Solana, and Dogecoin ETFs, with approvals likely hinging on Paul Atkins’ confirmation as SEC chair.
